prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: opaque square top-down vertically scrolling game terrain master, Emberwake Shipyards.
Input image: original Raptor industrial terrain source sheet is a style reference only, not an edit target. Match top-down orthographic steel-panel geometry, chunky readable geography and upper-left lighting.
Scene: a volcanic molten-metal shipyard. A dark blue-black channel occupies the central third, bordered by weathered gray steel repair-dock plates and gantry bases. Narrow glowing copper-orange slag runs cross only the outer edges, with black basalt rock and cooling slag heaps. Small unmanned steel cargo barges lie moored along the edges of the channel, compact service roads and industrial pads on either side. Muted gunmetal, charcoal basalt, rust-brown dock steel, restrained warm orange molten seams, dark navy water. No enemy vehicles, combat ships, people, projectiles or flames above the scene; combat sprites are separate.
Composition: entirely opaque square canvas, perfect top-down overhead without perspective/sky/horizon. Vertical scroll orientation, north/south channel and service routes; keep top and bottom bands compatible for a repeating terrain section, no framing or visible tile grid. Fill all pixels with geography. Fine HD industrial material details must read clearly at a 288 by 288 pixel old-game terrain sheet split into a 9 by 9 grid of 32-pixel tiles. Avoid bright lava covering playable center, photoreal perspective, enormous hero landmarks or text.
